expenses_void_check.name: expenses_void_check
expenses_void_check.value: "expenses"."status" <> 'voided' or ("expenses"."voided_at" is not null and "expenses"."void_reason" is not null)

payments_no_duplicate_ref.name: payments_no_duplicate_ref
payments_no_duplicate_ref.where: "payments"."reference" is not null and "payments"."status" = 'recorded' and "payments"."method" in ('upi', 'cheque', 'bank')
